import pandas as pd
import statsmodels.api as sm
from statsmodels.formula.api import ols

# Load the dataset
invaded_niche = pd.read_csv('/data/invaded_niche_pathways.csv')

# Display the first few rows of the dataset
invaded_niche.head()

# Define the model formula
formula = 'n.gard ~ cropland.1956.50m + urban.1956.50m + annual.temperature + annual.rainfall'

# Fit the model
model = ols(formula, data=invaded_niche).fit()

# Print the summary of the model
model.summary()
